approved_details: Objective: To evaluate the effects of a structured language intervention based on predictive coding theory (PCT) on the examination experience and completion status of patients undergoing conventional gastroscopy. Methods: A randomized controlled trial was conducted. The adult patients undergoing conventional gastroscopy at the First Medical Center of the Chinese PLA General Hospital between June and December 2025 were prospectively enrolled. The patients were randomly assigned to the intervention group and the control group using the random number table method. The control group received standard preoperative and intraoperative verbal guidance, whereas the intervention group received a PCT-based structured language intervention. The primary outcome was the discomfort score, assessed by the visual analogue scale (VAS) immediately after gastroscopy, while the secondary outcomes were endoscopic operation time, endoscopic operation termination rate, and the proportion of patients willing to undergo regular gastroscopy again. Independent samples t -test, Mann-Whitney U test or χ² test were used to compare the primary and secondary outcomes between the two groups. Results: A total of 150 patients were enrolled, including 83 males and 67 females, aged (49±3) years. The intervention group and control group each included 75 patients. Compared to the control group, the intervention group had a significantly lower VAS discomfort score [3 (3, 4) vs 6 (5, 7), P <0.001], shorter endoscopic operation duration [(9.7±0.9) vs (13.0±1.2) min, P <0.001], and a higher proportion of patients willing to repeat gastroscopy [92.0% (69/75) vs 68.0% (51/75), P <0.001]. There was no statistically significant difference in procedure termination rates between the two groups [1.3% (1/75) vs 4.0% (3/75), P =0.311]. Conclusion: The structured language intervention based on PCT can reduce patients' discomfort, shorten operation duration, and promote willingness for repeated gastroscopy. 目的： 分析基于预测编码理论（PCT）的程序化语言干预方案对行普通胃镜检查患者的检查体验及完成情况的影响。 方法： 随机对照研究。前瞻性纳入2025年6至12月于解放军总医院第一医学中心接受普通胃镜检查的成年患者，按随机数字表法分为干预组和对照组，对照组接受常规术前及术中口头指导，干预组接受基于PCT的程序化语言干预方案。主要结局指标为检查结束后即刻采用视觉模拟量表（VAS）评估的不适评分，次要结局为内镜操作时间、内镜操作中止率及患者愿意再次接受普通胃镜检查的比例。采用独立样本 t 检验、Mann-Whitney U 检验或χ²检验比较两组主要结局和次要结局的差异。 结果： 共纳入150例患者，男83例，女67例，年龄（49±3）岁；干预组和对照组各75例。干预组患者VAS评分低于对照组［3（3，4）比6（5，7）分， P <0.001］，内镜操作时间短于对照组［（9.7±0.9）比（13.0±1.2）min， P <0.001］，愿意再次检查的比例高于对照组［92.0%（69/75）比68.0%（51/75）， P <0.001］；两组操作中止率差异无统计学意义［1.3%（1/75）比4.0%（3/75）， P =0.311］。 结论： 基于PCT的程序化语言干预方案可降低患者对普通胃镜检查的不适感，缩短操作时间，提高患者再次接受检查的意愿。.
